generation.scope: Every characteristic-zero ordinary rank-fourteen window with ordinary geometric reduction in characteristic 101 is standard Koszul and AS regular in every degree, including arbitrarily large residue extensions. Every ordinary root-of-unity value of the rational parameter t is regular on both components, by an auxiliary calculation at 109.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed saturated PID kernels, maximal-minor ideals via row and column bases, both eigenvalues after etale splitting, lifting central sections and reduction of cyclotomic conjugates.

mathematical_computation.scope: Computed all dual path kernels and maximal-minor supports through length thirteen over F101[t] for both starts and signs, checked exceptional orbits in extension fields and repeated the generic calculation at 109 to cover the remaining cyclotomic orders.

open_mathematics: Settle the finite characteristic-zero exceptional locus of the rank-fourteen components. For a putative bad closed point, every reduction over 101 lies on the explicit nonordinary boundary or at infinity. Study the finitely many residue disks by saturating quadratic and central sections on the compactified curve (local uniformizers, leading minors in characteristic zero and modulo 101). In parallel methodologically, the exact dual path/Fitting recursion can be run over Q(i)[t] with modular reconstruction. Use the cyclotomic and degree-six results as proved inputs.
